scope: source-pinned planning rules, not current runtime capabilities or scientific proof
authority: Actual registered version/parser overrides historical observations and latest public manuals. Defaults need current-source verification.

basic.rule: Bind and inspect actual labeled assets. testSet is used as validation during training/checkpoint selection, not an independent final test.
Match available labels and target; ordinary energy/forces and optional virial are distinct from dipole/polar targets.
Choose a justified proposal from supplied config/model/system; required top-level source field, not in DefaultPara.
Propose bounded pilot or requested budget; do not silently use long source defaults10000epochs/1e6steps as a short example.
Choose ASE atomic-number export for PyDyn; preserve species meaning/order and separate LAMMPS type-index consumer.

automatic_technical: explicit saved seed, owned working/output directories and immutable inputs
data counts/species/cell/PBC/label masks and split hashes
source-derived architecture defaults as annotated proposals, not user blanks
readiness: actual dataset/config paths imported without parent-root grants
no validation/test leakage; report independent test separately
missing virial stays missing, never zero-filled RMSE
stress/virial sign conversion checked; source maps virial=-volume*stress
checkpoint versus eager model versus ase/lammps scripted artifact explicit
freeze selected output saved/reloaded on actual consumer before MD readiness
consumer_hazards: HotPP package name miaonet differs from import/CLI hotpp
freeze mutates embedding representation for LAMMPS only after saving ASE artifact; outputs are not interchangeable
AIMatterLab hotpp.eval currently passes no properties override, so default energy/forces eval must not be called a dipole/virial evaluation
AIMatterLab export fixes CUDA+double; tutorial CPU/default freeze is not current adapter behavior
branch acceleration report numbers are historical, not this campaign speed or generic support
